title: Task 3 - Concerto model generation item
description: Given only the clause text, the model generates a complete Concerto data model. The primary metric is type-multiset coverage: treating each model as a bag of types and measuring the share of gold types recovered, independent of field names. Generated models are additionally validated with the official Accord ModelManager from concerto-core.

id.description: Unique item id, of the form <template-name>-modelgen-01.

input.description: The clause text, with titles and headings stripped. This is the model's only input.

expected_output.description: Gold map from property name to Concerto type, parsed from the template's @template block. Where a template stores data in nested lists or sub-concepts the parser recovers only the top-level field, producing a few thin gold answers (volumediscountolist, volumediscountulist, docusign-connect); these are flagged in the dissertation rather than silently dropped.
